summary: Converge SQLite projection under concurrent ticket writes

delivery.outcome: Repair existing PLF-21260: converge the derived SQLite index despite concurrent canonical ticket/evidence writes, without scanning the archive under the mutation lock or requiring a quiet interval.
nonGoals: No live database deletion, lock takeover, index disable or authoritative active/history migration.
No relaxing full-view freshness or treating source publication as native activation.

architecture.decision: Build outside the canonical writer lock. Reconcile only changed sprint and evidence sources in a bounded final writer-lock section. Refuse oversized or ambiguous locator drift, preserve existing contention/corruption handling, and let maintenance attempt the newest source state without waiting for quiescence.

dataChanges.description: Reconcile the existing disposable SQLite projection; authoritative YAML/evidence ownership, formats and storage remain unchanged.

architecture.rollback: Revert the published source; preserve all canonical data, index files and live owner locks.

validation.evidence: Barrier-controlled independent canonical writes during a full scan converge in one build; new, updated and evidence-projected payloads are exact and subsequent writes remain incrementally current. Oversized/locator races remain fail-closed.

commands: protected OneDev exact-head/current-base verification and independent Validator publication
validation.evidence: Existing contention, descriptor, freshness, lifecycle and sharded regressions remain covered; source merge and native qualification recorded separately.
